verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם יְהוָ֛ה דִּבֶּ֧ר אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏōṯ ’a·hă·rōn ū·mō·šeh bə·yō·wm Yah·weh dib·ber ’eṯ- mō·šeh bə·har sî·nāy
verses.literal: This is the account of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן נָדָ֑ב הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀ וַאֲבִיה֕וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê- ’a·hă·rōn nā·ḏāḇ hab·bə·ḵō·wr wa·’ă·ḇî·hū ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: These are the names of the sons of Aaron Nadab the firstborn then Abihu Eleazar and Ithamar

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה אַהֲרֹ֔ן שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַמְּשֻׁחִ֑ים הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר־ מִלֵּ֥א יָדָ֖ם לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ’a·hă·rōn šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê ham·mə·šu·ḥîm hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ă·šer- mil·lê yā·ḏām lə·ḵa·hên
verses.literal: These [were] Aaron’s - sons the anointed priests who were ordained . . . to serve as priests

verses.original: נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֣וּא וַיָּ֣מָת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֡ה בְּֽהַקְרִבָם֩ זָרָ֜ה אֵ֨שׁ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם לֹא־ וּבָנִ֖ים אֶלְעָזָר֙ וְאִ֣יתָמָ֔ר וַיְכַהֵ֤ן עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י אֲבִיהֶֽם׃פ אַהֲרֹ֥ן
verses.transliteration: nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū way·yā·māṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh bə·haq·ri·ḇām zā·rāh ’êš lip̄·nê Yah·weh bə·miḏ·bar sî·nay hā·yū lā·hem lō- ū·ḇā·nîm ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’î·ṯā·mār way·ḵa·hên ‘al- pə·nê ’ă·ḇî·hem ’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: Nadab and Abihu, however died in the presence of the LORD when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai And since they had no sons only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: הַקְרֵב֙ מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֔י אֶת־ וְֽהַעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְשֵׁרְת֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: haq·rêḇ maṭ·ṭêh lê·wî ’eṯ- wə·ha·‘ă·maḏ·tā ’ō·ṯōw lip̄·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên wə·šê·rə·ṯū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Bring the tribe of Levi - and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him -

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗וֹ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·mar·tōw wə·’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh lip̄·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: They are to perform - duties for him - - and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting attending - to the service of the tabernacle

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֗וּ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵי֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- kāl- kə·lê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: They shall take care of - all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites . . . by attending - to the service of the tabernacle

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּה֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו הֵ֙מָּה֙ נְתוּנִ֨ם נְתוּנִ֥ם ל֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw hêm·māh nə·ṯū·nim nə·ṯū·nim lōw mê·’êṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Assign - the Levites to Aaron and his sons they have been given exclusively . . . to him from among the Israelites . . .

verses.original: וְאֶת־ תִּפְקֹ֔ד אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־ בָּנָיו֙ וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־ כְּהֻנָּתָ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- tip̄·qōḏ ’a·hă·rōn wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- kə·hun·nā·ṯām wə·haz·zār haq·qā·rêḇ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: So you shall appoint Aaron - and his sons to carry out - the duties of the priesthood but any outsider who approaches [the tabernacle] must be put to death

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD spoke to Moses saying

verses.original: הִנֵּ֧ה וַאֲנִ֞י לָקַ֣חְתִּי אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִתּוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תַּ֧חַת כָּל־ בְּכ֛וֹר פֶּ֥טֶר מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רֶ֖חֶם הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh wa·’ă·nî lā·qaḥ·tî ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim mit·tō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ta·ḥaṯ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr pe·ṭer mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl re·ḥem hal·wî·yim wə·hā·yū lî
verses.literal: Behold I have taken - the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every . . . firstborn Israelite . . . from the womb The Levites belong to Me

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֒ לִי֮ בְּיוֹם֩ הַכֹּתִ֨י כָל־ בְּכ֜וֹר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי לִ֤י כָל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאָדָ֖ם עַד־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה יִהְי֖וּ לִ֥י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî kāl- bə·ḵō·wr lî bə·yō·wm hak·kō·ṯî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim hiq·daš·tî lî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr bə·yiś·rā·’êl mê·’ā·ḏām ‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh yih·yū lî ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: for all the firstborn [are] Mine On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel both man and beast They are Mine I am the LORD

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh bə·miḏ·bar sî·nay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai saying

verses.original: פְּקֹד֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם תִּפְקְדֵֽם׃ כָּל־ זָכָ֛ר חֹ֥דֶשׁ מִבֶּן־ וָמַ֖עְלָה
verses.transliteration: pə·qōḏ ’eṯ- bə·nê lê·wî ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām tip̄·qə·ḏêm kāl- zā·ḵār ḥō·ḏeš mib·ben- wā·ma‘·lāh
verses.literal: Number - the Levites . . . by their families . . . and clans You are to count every male a month old or more

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָ֛ם עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צֻוָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yip̄·qōḏ ’ō·ṯām ‘al- pî Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ṣuw·wāh
verses.literal: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD as he had been commanded

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה וַיִּֽהְיוּ־ בְנֵֽי־ לֵוִ֖י בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh way·yih·yū- ḇə·nê- lê·wî biš·mō·ṯām gê·rə·šō·wn ū·qə·hāṯ ū·mə·rā·rî
verses.literal: These were the sons of Levi by name Gershon Kohath and Merari

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם לִבְנִ֖י וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê- ḡê·rə·šō·wn lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām liḇ·nî wə·šim·‘î
verses.literal: These were the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans Libni and Shimei

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר חֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê qə·hāṯ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ‘am·rām wə·yiṣ·hār ḥeḇ·rō·wn wə·‘uz·zî·’êl
verses.literal: The sons of Kohath by their clans were Amram Izhar Hebron and Uzziel

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֛ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י אֲבֹתָֽם׃ לְבֵ֥ית
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê mə·rā·rî lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām maḥ·lî ū·mū·šî ’êl·leh hêm miš·pə·ḥōṯ hal·lê·wî ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ
verses.literal: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi These were the clans of the Levites according to their families . . .

verses.original: לְגֵ֣רְשׁ֔וֹן הַלִּבְנִ֔י מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַשִּׁמְעִ֑י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֔ם הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת
verses.transliteration: lə·ḡê·rə·šō·wn hal·liḇ·nî miš·pa·ḥaṯ haš·šim·‘î ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ ’êl·leh hêm hag·gê·rə·šun·nî miš·pə·ḥōṯ
verses.literal: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan these . . . were the Gershonite clans

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ מִבֶּן־ וָמָ֑עְלָה פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem bə·mis·par kāl- zā·ḵār ḥō·ḏeš mib·ben- wā·mā·‘ə·lāh pə·qu·ḏê·hem šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The number . . . of all the males a month old or more was 7,500 . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת יַחֲנ֖וּ יָֽמָּה׃ אַחֲרֵ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן
verses.transliteration: hag·gê·rə·šun·nî miš·pə·ḥōṯ ya·ḥă·nū yām·māh ’a·ḥă·rê ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west behind the tabernacle

verses.original: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־ אָ֖ב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ לָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śî ḇêṯ- ’āḇ lag·gê·rə·šun·nî ’el·yā·sāp̄ ben- lā·’êl
verses.literal: and the leader of the families . . . of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael

verses.original: וּמִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת בְּנֵֽי־ גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְהָאֹ֑הֶל מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמָסַ֕ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·me·reṯ bə·nê- ḡê·rə·šō·wn bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ham·miš·kān wə·hā·’ō·hel miḵ·sê·hū ū·mā·saḵ pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: The duties of the Gershonites . . . at the Tent of Meeting [were] the tabernacle and tent its covering the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וְקַלְעֵ֣י הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר וְאֶת־ מָסַךְ֙ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְעַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִ֑יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתָרָ֔יו לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qal·‘ê he·ḥā·ṣêr wə·’eṯ- mā·saḵ pe·ṯaḥ he·ḥā·ṣêr ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·miš·kān wə·‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ sā·ḇîḇ wə·’êṯ mê·ṯā·rāw lə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw
verses.literal: the curtains of the courtyard - the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle . . . and altar . . . - and the cords all the service [for these items]

verses.original: וְלִקְהָ֗ת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ הַיִּצְהָרִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַֽחֶבְרֹנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הָֽעָזִּיאֵלִ֑י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקְּהָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liq·hāṯ miš·pa·ḥaṯ ha·‘am·rā·mî hay·yiṣ·hā·rî ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ ha·ḥeḇ·rō·nî ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ hā·‘āz·zî·’ê·lî ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ ’êl·leh hêm miš·pə·ḥōṯ haq·qə·hā·ṯî
verses.literal: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites the Izharites the Hebronites and the Uzzielites these . . . were the clans of the Kohathites

verses.original: בְּמִסְפַּר֙ כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ מִבֶּן־ וָמָ֑עְלָה שְׁמֹנַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·mis·par kāl- zā·ḵār ḥō·ḏeš mib·ben- wā·mā·‘ə·lāh šə·mō·naṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600 . . . . . . . . . They were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary

verses.original: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־ קְהָ֖ת יַחֲנ֑וּ עַ֛ל תֵּימָֽנָה׃ יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן
verses.transliteration: miš·pə·ḥōṯ bə·nê- qə·hāṯ ya·ḥă·nū ‘al tê·mā·nāh ye·reḵ ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: The clans of the Kohathites . . . were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle

verses.original: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־ אָ֖ב הַקְּהָתִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת אֶלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן־ עֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śî ḇêṯ- ’āḇ haq·qə·hā·ṯî lə·miš·pə·ḥōṯ ʾɛ·lī·ṣå̄·p̄å̄n ben- ‘uz·zî·’êl
verses.literal: and the leader of the families . . . of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel

verses.original: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּ֗ם הָאָרֹ֤ן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְהַמְּנֹרָ֣ה וְהַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֔ת וּכְלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְת֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨מָּסָ֔ךְ וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·mar·tām hā·’ā·rōn wə·haš·šul·ḥān wə·ham·mə·nō·rāh wə·ham·miz·bə·ḥōṯ ū·ḵə·lê haq·qō·ḏeš ’ă·šer yə·šā·rə·ṯū bā·hem wə·ham·mā·sāḵ wə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Their duties [were] the ark the table the lampstand the altars the articles of the sanctuary - used with them and the curtain all the service [for these items]

verses.original: וּנְשִׂיא֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַלֵּוִ֔י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן פְּקֻדַּ֕ת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śî nə·śî·’ê hal·lê·wî ’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên pə·qud·daṯ šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The chief of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest he oversaw those responsible for the duties of the sanctuary

verses.original: לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַמַּחְלִ֔י הַמּוּשִׁ֑י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מְרָרִֽי׃ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת
verses.transliteration: lim·rā·rî miš·pa·ḥaṯ ham·maḥ·lî ham·mū·šî ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ ’êl·leh hêm mə·rā·rî miš·pə·ḥōṯ
verses.literal: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites . . . these . . . were the Merarite clans

verses.original: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ מִבֶּן־ וָמָ֑עְלָה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem bə·mis·par kāl- zā·ḵār ḥō·ḏeš mib·ben- wā·mā·‘ə·lāh šê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·mā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: The number . . . of all the males a month old or more was 6,200 . . . . . .

verses.original: וּנְשִׂ֤יא בֵֽית־ אָב֙ מְרָרִ֔י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת צוּרִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ אֲבִיחָ֑יִל יַחֲנ֖וּ עַ֣ל צָפֹֽנָה׃ יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śî ḇêṯ- ’āḇ mə·rā·rî lə·miš·pə·ḥōṯ ṣū·rî·’êl ben- ’ă·ḇî·ḥā·yil ya·ḥă·nū ‘al ṣā·p̄ō·nāh ye·reḵ ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: The leader of the families . . . of the Merarites - was Zuriel son of Abihail they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle

verses.original: מִשְׁמֶרֶת֮ וּפְקֻדַּ֣ת בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֒ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן קַרְשֵׁי֙ וּבְרִיחָ֖יו וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו וַאֲדָנָ֑יו וְכָל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: miš·me·reṯ ū·p̄ə·qud·daṯ bə·nê mə·rā·rî ham·miš·kān qar·šê ū·ḇə·rî·ḥāw wə·‘am·mu·ḏāw wa·’ă·ḏā·nāw wə·ḵāl kê·lāw wə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw
verses.literal: The duties assigned to the sons of Merari were the tabernacle’s frames crossbars posts bases and all its equipment all the service for these [items]

verses.original: וְעַמֻּדֵ֧י סָבִ֖יב הֶחָצֵ֛ר וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֑ם וִיתֵדֹתָ֖ם וּמֵֽיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘am·mu·ḏê sā·ḇîḇ he·ḥā·ṣêr wə·’aḏ·nê·hem wî·ṯê·ḏō·ṯām ū·mê·ṯə·rê·hem
verses.literal: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases tent pegs and ropes

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֣ה׀ וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו וְהַחֹנִ֣ים קֵ֣דְמָה לִפְנֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֡ן מִזְרָ֜חָה לִפְנֵי֩ אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֨ד׀ שֹֽׁמְרִים֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּקְדָּ֔שׁ לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ū·ḇā·nāw wə·ha·ḥō·nîm qê·ḏə·māh lip̄·nê ham·miš·kān miz·rā·ḥāh lip̄·nê ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ šō·mə·rîm miš·me·reṯ ham·miq·dāš lə·miš·me·reṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·haz·zār haq·qā·rêḇ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Moses Aaron and [Aaron’s sons] were to camp to the east of the tabernacle toward the sunrise before the Tent of Meeting They were to perform the duties of the sanctuary as a service vvv on behalf of the Israelites but any outsider who approached [the sanctuary] was to be put to death

verses.original: כָּל־ פְּקוּדֵ֨י הַלְוִיִּ֜ם אֲשֶׁר֩ מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְׄאַׄהֲׄרֹ֛ׄןׄ פָּקַ֨ד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה פִּ֥י כָּל־ זָכָר֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ מִבֶּן־ וָמַ֔עְלָה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- pə·qū·ḏê hal·wî·yim ’ă·šer mō·šeh wə·ʾa·hă·rōn pā·qaḏ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ‘al- Yah·weh pî kāl- zā·ḵār ḥō·ḏeš mib·ben- wā·ma‘·lāh šə·na·yim wə·‘eś·rîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The total number of Levites that Moses and Aaron counted by their clans at the LORD’s command including all the males a month old or more was 22,000 . . . . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה פְּקֹ֨ד כָּל־ בְּכֹ֤ר זָכָר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חֹ֖דֶשׁ מִבֶּן־ וָמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂ֕א אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁמֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·yō·mer mō·šeh pə·qōḏ kāl- bə·ḵōr zā·ḵār liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ḥō·ḏeš mib·ben- wā·mā·‘ə·lāh wə·śā ’êṯ mis·par šə·mō·ṯām
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . said to Moses Number every firstborn male vvv of the Israelites a month old or more and list - - their names

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֨ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֥ם לִי֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה תַּ֥חַת כָּל־ בְּכֹ֖ר בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֵת֙ בֶּהֱמַ֣ת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֣חַת כָּל־ בְּכ֔וֹר בְּבֶהֱמַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim lî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ta·ḥaṯ kāl- bə·ḵōr biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’êṯ be·hĕ·maṯ hal·wî·yim ta·ḥaṯ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr bə·ḇe·hĕ·maṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: You are to take - the Levites for Me I am the LORD in place of all the firstborn vvv of Israel - and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock vvv of the Israelites

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּפְקֹ֣ד כָּל־ בְּכֹ֖ר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֑וֹ אֶֽת־
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yip̄·qōḏ kāl- bə·ḵōr biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh ’ō·ṯōw ’eṯ-
verses.literal: So Moses numbered all the firstborn vvv of the Israelites as the LORD had commanded him -

verses.original: כָל־ לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם בְּכ֨וֹר זָכָ֜ר חֹ֥דֶשׁ מִבֶּן־ וָמַ֖עְלָה בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמ֛וֹת וַיְהִי֩ שְׁנַ֤יִם וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḵāl lip̄·qu·ḏê·hem bə·ḵō·wr zā·ḵār ḥō·ḏeš mib·ben- wā·ma‘·lāh bə·mis·par šê·mō·wṯ way·hî šə·na·yim wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ šə·lō·šāh wə·šiḇ·‘îm ū·mā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: The total number of the firstborn males a month old or more listed by name was 22,273 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD spoke to Moses saying

verses.original: קַ֣ח אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם תַּ֤חַת כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם תַּ֣חַת בְּהֶמְתָּ֑ם הַלְוִיִּ֖ם וְהָיוּ־ לִ֥י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim ta·ḥaṯ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- be·hĕ·maṯ hal·wî·yim ta·ḥaṯ bə·hem·tām hal·wî·yim wə·hā·yū- lî ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Take - the Levites in place of all the firstborn vvv of Israel and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock The Levites belong to Me I am the LORD

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ פְּדוּיֵ֣י הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְהַשִּׁבְעִ֖ים וְהַמָּאתָ֑יִם מִבְּכ֖וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ הָעֹֽדְפִים֙ עַל־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ pə·ḏū·yê haš·šə·lō·šāh wə·haš·šiḇ·‘îm wə·ham·mā·ṯā·yim mib·bə·ḵō·wr bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hā·‘ō·ḏə·p̄îm ‘al- hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: - To redeem the 273 . . . . . . firstborn Israelites . . . who outnumber . . . the Levites

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֗ חֲמֵ֧שֶׁת חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים לַגֻּלְגֹּ֑לֶת הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ תִּקָּ֔ח בְּשֶׁ֤קֶל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ḥă·mê·šeṯ ḥă·mê·šeṯ šə·qā·lîm lag·gul·gō·leṯ haq·qō·ḏeš tiq·qāḥ bə·še·qel ‘eś·rîm gê·rāh haš·šā·qel
verses.literal: you are to collect five . . . shekels for each one according to the sanctuary . . . shekel of twenty gerahs . . .

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה הַכֶּ֔סֶף לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו פְּדוּיֵ֕י הָעֹדְפִ֖ים בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh hak·ke·sep̄ lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw pə·ḏū·yê hā·‘ō·ḏə·p̄îm bā·hem
verses.literal: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among [the Israelites]

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת וַיִּקַּ֣ח הַפִּדְי֑וֹם מֵאֵת֙ כֶּ֣סֶף הָעֹ֣דְפִ֔ים עַ֖ל פְּדוּיֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’êṯ way·yiq·qaḥ hap·piḏ·yō·wm mê·’êṯ ke·sep̄ hā·‘ō·ḏə·p̄îm ‘al pə·ḏū·yê hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: So Moses - collected the redemption . . . money from those in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites

verses.original: מֵאֵ֗ת לָקַ֣ח אֶת־ הַכָּ֑סֶף בְּכ֛וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֜ים וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וָאֶ֖לֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’êṯ lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- hak·kā·sep̄ bə·ḵō·wr bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ḥă·miš·šāh wə·šiš·šîm ū·šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ wā·’e·lep̄ bə·še·qel haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: - He collected - the money from the firstborn vvv of the Israelites 1,365 . . . . . . . . . . . . shekels according to the sanctuary shekel

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַפְּדֻיִ֛ם כֶּ֧סֶף לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן וּלְבָנָ֖יו עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·yit·tên hap·pə·ḏu·yim ke·sep̄ lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw ‘al- pî Yah·weh ’eṯ- ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh
verses.literal: And Moses - gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons in obedience to the word of the LORD - just as the LORD had commanded [him]
